name: How do I maintain my grab bars to ensure they remain safe?

mainEntity.name: How do I maintain my grab bars to ensure they remain safe?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintaining grab bars is straightforward. Regularly inspect them for any signs of looseness, corrosion, or damage, especially at the mounting points. Tighten any loose screws promptly. Clean them with a non-abrasive cleaner and a soft cloth to prevent buildup and maintain their finish. Avoid using harsh chemicals that could degrade the material. Proper maintenance ensures the grab bars remain securely attached and safe for continued use, providing reliable support for years.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintain grab bars by regularly checking for looseness or damage, tightening screws, and cleaning with non-abrasive cleaners to ensure continued safety and integrity.
